name: AmberX walkthrough video
description: Make or re-record an app walkthrough video. Owned by the Walkthrough producer; takes over the amberx-walkthrough build's outputs and re-record command when that build lands.
author: AmberX AXF

inputs.label: Flow
inputs.about: what the video shows, in order

data.brief:
Make (or re-record) the walkthrough video of {{app}}: {{flow}}. Reason: {{reason}}.
Use the walkthrough tooling already in the repo (apps/walkthrough-studio, the molly-guide walkthrough@1 scripts); when the amberx-walkthrough build has landed, run its re-record command instead of recording by hand. Keep the old video until the new one is checked.
Report: the video path or link, its length, the screens it covers, and anything that looked broken while recording.
